'''Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport''' [[teleport]]s the caster to [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]]. In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]]. Completion of the quest [[Priest in Peril]] and receiving [[Drezel]]'s warning is required to use the teleport.
